name: STRATUS
recent: Stratus Global 公布了截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩，并宣派每股 0.80 仙的首次中期股息。公司主席在 8 月至 10 月期间多次在公开市场减持股份。EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报权益变动。
notable: 宣派截至 2027 年 3 月 31 日财年的首次中期单层股息每股 0.80 仙。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的季度业绩。
主席 Fazrin Azwar Bin Md. Nor 在 2026 年 8 月至 10 月期间多次在公开市场减持股份。
risks: 主席在 2026 年 8 月至 10 月期间多次减持公司股份。
EPF 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报权益变动，包括成为主要股东及不再作为主要股东。

recent_en: Stratus Global announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 and declared a first interim dividend of 0.80 sen per share. The company chairman disposed of shares in the open market several times between August and October. EPF filed multiple changes in its interest between October and November.
notable_en: Declared a first interim single-tier dividend of 0.80 sen per share for the financial year ending 31 March 2027.
Announced quarterly results for the financial period ended 30 September 2026.
Chairman Fazrin Azwar Bin Md. Nor disposed of shares in the open market multiple times between August and October 2026.
risks_en: The chairman disposed of company shares multiple times between August and October 2026.
EPF filed multiple changes in its interest between October and November 2026, including becoming a substantial shareholder and ceasing to be one.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM34,844,000 and net income was RM9,548,000, with a net margin of 27.4%.
